ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity for September 02, 2026, repurchasing 58,083 equity shares from the open market at an average price of ₹295.3153. This transaction increases the cumulative shares bought back under the program to 941,885, effectively reducing the company's outstanding share count. The report is a standard regulatory disclosure for an ongoing buyback and presents no immediate red flags.
